hooks.command: if python3 --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then :; else echo 'odoo-tools: python3 is not runnable, so the Odoo MCP server cannot start. It needs Python 3.9+ available as python3 (see the plugin README, Requirements).'; fi
if python3 -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 9))' >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/check_options.py"; fi
